feature: Interactive Ellipse modes and corrected command axis measurement

profiles.comparison: Full geometry, selection, markers, lengths and actual Undo/Redo at 1e-6 through command and frontend; basic modes and numeric axis sizing.
Full geometry/history at 1e-6; signed sides, spatial and rotated planes, relative points, centered Corner switch, and explicit remembered-focus setup.

Full geometry/history at 1e-6; prior skew-command regression, vertical axis normal to CPlane, spatial diameters, numeric replacements, focal apex picks, marker toggle and default-mode focus suppression.
Full geometry/history at 1e-6; Corner diagonal locks and collinear focal fallback with reversed, spatial and normal axes.
Full geometry/history at 1e-6; rotated collinear focal fallbacks, off-plane 3D Corner diagonal locks and rotated relative vectors.
Five native Failure and three native Cancel outcomes with complete input receipts and no model output; local invalid inputs retain the getter and create no helpers.
Excluded from successful geometry qualification: one incomplete failed vertical-input attempt and one successful implicit preference dependency.
Excluded from successful geometry qualification: negative numeric behavior and three cursor-dependent Enter attempts with timeout or incomplete receipts.

qualifications: Default, Vertical, Diameter, Diameter Vertical, Corner and FromFoci input share one edit-free command/frontend constructor; the Corner switch after a center retains that center.

The command now measures the perpendicular second-axis component, correcting the old full-vector radius. RhinoCommon-compatible Ellipse3::try_from_three_points retains its existing full-vector behavior.

Positive numeric axis locks and replacements require direction input; Diameter numeric values are full diameters, while point picks on the second axis specify a radius. Corner uses diagonal length locks.
Spatial first axes, rotated CPlanes, second-axis sides, relative input, CPlane Corner projection, and vertical-axis/collinear-foci fallbacks compare at 1e-6.

FromFoci uses a stable distance-excess calculation for the minor radius instead of subtracting squared lengths; a separate thin-ellipse regression preserves a 1e-3 minor radius with 1e8 focal distance.
Focus markers precede the curve in native second-focus/first-focus order. MarkFoci is remembered per registry after success, retained across Undo/Redo, and suppressed in other modes.

Full controls, weights, knots, domains, lengths, marker positions/order, selection and actual history compare for all 55 workflows in both command and frontend tests. Native-feature frontend and command/oracle regressions are also run.

Locked-preview Enter uses the shared filtered point pipeline with the latest viewport hover; no hover keeps the getter open. Local tests cover this, units, filters, pure previews, retries, cancellation and command interruption.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Sixteen successful managed public getter workflows.
Eighteen qualified direction/plane/relative/preference workflows plus two separate diagnostics.
Eleven successful final workflows, seven clean failure/cancellation controls and one timed-out cursor-input diagnostic.
Five rotated focal, 3D Corner lock and relative-vector workflows; canonical focal replay retains the captured plane.
Five successful numeric/focal fallback workflows, one clean failure and three unqualified negative/cursor diagnostics.

metric_policy: Fifty-five successful native getter workflows are compared at absolute 1e-6; failure/cancellation rows and all incomplete, uncontrolled-cursor, negative-numeric or implicit-state diagnostics remain separate. Initial adapter/prompt-gate failures and aborted incomplete macro experiments are excluded. No physical viewport aperture or performance parity is claimed.
unqualified: AroundCurve and deformable Ellipse output remain unimplemented
Negative sizes are rejected; the captured native negative-number behavior is diagnostic only
Exhaustive physical mouse/snap behavior and exact geometry replay of cursor-quantized Enter inputs
Native failure termination and preference updates on cancellation; local invalid inputs allow retries and pending preferences save only after success
Extreme parameter ranges and performance parity
